user.title: Presence Detection Designer - Room Setup
user.description: Configure presence detection boundaries, triggers, Bayesian probability fusion, timeouts, and optional AI vision verification for this room.

data.llm_agent_id: Home Assistant Conversation / AI Task Entity ID

data_description.room_name: Friendly name for this room (e.g. Living Room, Office, Master Bedroom).
data_description.area_id: Assign the created room presence device to a Home Assistant Area.
data_description.mode: Select 'bounded' if the room has physical door contact sensors (Wasp-in-a-Box), or 'open' for rooms without door sensors.
data_description.boundary_entities: Door or gate contact sensors marking the boundary perimeter. When closed, presence is sealed inside.
data_description.trigger_entities: Motion sensors, mmWave presence sensors, or Frigate person detection sensors inside the room.
data_description.sustaining_conditions: List of condition rules ({entity_id, operator, state, label}) that sustain room presence without motion.
data_description.bayesian_enabled: Enable Bayesian probability calculation and natural-language sensor explanations.
data_description.bayesian_prior: Baseline probability of occupancy before sensor evidence is applied (default: 0.20).
data_description.bayesian_threshold: Posterior probability required to declare the room occupied (default: 0.75).
data_description.bayesian_observations: List of Bayesian sensor observations ({entity_id, label, preset, operator, state}) with preset in [decisive, strong, moderate, supporting].
data_description.inactivity_timeout: Seconds to wait after motion clears before vacating an open area or unsealed room (default: 300).
data_description.grace_timeout: Seconds of stillness allowed while door boundary is open before clearing presence (default: 60).
data_description.extend_timeout: Additional seconds added when an AI vision verification detects a person sitting still (default: 300).
data_description.llm_enabled: Use a Vision LLM (OpenAI, Gemini, LiteLLM, Ollama) to visually confirm human presence before clearing occupancy.
data_description.llm_provider_type: Select 'vision_api' for OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoints (LiteLLM, OpenAI, Ollama), 'conversation' for HA Conversation agents, or 'ai_task' for HA AI Task entities.
data_description.camera_entity: Home Assistant camera entity to capture snapshots from for visual verification.
data_description.camera_snapshot_url: Direct snapshot path (such as /api/camera/latest.jpg) if not using a Home Assistant camera entity.
data_description.llm_agent_id: Optional Home Assistant conversation agent ID or ai_task entity ID.
data_description.llm_api_url: OpenAI-compatible chat completion endpoint path (such as http://10.0.0.10:8448/v1/chat/completions).
data_description.llm_api_key: API key for the LLM provider (leave blank if your local endpoint requires no authentication).
data_description.llm_model: Model identifier with vision/chat capabilities (e.g. gemini-2.5-flash, gpt-4o-mini, qwen3-vl-32b-instruct).

error.invalid_name: Please provide a valid, non-empty room name.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred while setting up the room.
